I recommend this to anyone that has to crush medication for yourself or someone else..it does a fantastic job and it’s made of heavy glass so no pitting issues like you get with those plastic ones!!I use this for grinding up "spices". I couldn't be happier. Turns everything into an EXTREMELY fine powder in a short amount of time. It isn't porus so you don't any spices. Easy to clean, easy to use.Purchased this to pulverize pills for my dog. Made it easier to mix with her food as she would spit the pills out if they were intact.This is the perfect size if compounding small batches of medication or if using for herbs and spices. It’s very durable and easy to clean. I have not experienced any issues.I use this a lot to crush up pills for my dog. It's a nice heavy glass and works quite well.My little dog has some pills to take that are too big for her mouth. I bought this to crush the pills for her dinner. After a few weeks of use twice a day, I am quite satisfied. It works very well to crush the pills right down to a fine powder, which I wasn't able to do before.This mortar and pestle are the perfect size for my purpose. I got it to grind up some pills for one of my dogs so I can mix it in her food. She’s normally not too picky, but I had a challenge ahead of me trying to grind it up fine enough to slip into her food. This makes the job much easier, and I love that it has the spout on it and the way it looks. Very happy with my purchase!It worked and looked much much better than expected if u need sum powdered bc you like to ugh "smell" it this makes easy quick work and no loss plus the fine powder make those scents go a lottttt furtherI bought this to grind up my dogs arthritis pills, since she will not take a tablet, no matter what I hide it in. This mortar and pestle makes the job easy. I cut the tablet in half with a pill splitter and then crush the halves . I lean the mortar to one side to make it easier to "catch" the pills. Hide the dust in a little cottage cheese and its done. I like the clear mortar because its easy to see that I got all of the crushed pill.I used this to crush my soft pastels for brush applications for artwork. For this reason I chose this product. The spout helped immensely for transferring my pastel powders into a smaller receptacle. Some slight sticking, but this was likely due to the consistency of soft pastels. I have not used it for it's designed useage with herbs and spices.
reviews_1s:
Needed this for meds and it was cheap, gave it a try. The act of grinding down stubborn pills can require a touch of elbow grease, and tonight I tilted the bowl juuuuust a tiny bit while I was grinding. Unwise. Next moment I'm holding a fistful of shattered glass, the bowl has a big empthy v-shape at the shatterpoint, and there are dozens of shards of glass **mixed in* with my ground up meds. I'm not all that upset, it's not mouch blood to clean up.

But I am posting here to be a good neighbor. If you are a senior citizen, have children in the house, or maybe a loved one that's not safe to take care of themselves. Woe betide you if something happens to them because you bought one of these.The glass pestle is smooth at the bulb part that grinds the pills. The result is each pill slips away from the pestle. Every pestle we've ever had has a rough finish on the bulb part which allows some grip on the pill to be crushed. This is so poorly designed we tossed in the trash rather than donate it as we normally do with unneeded household items. Beautifully made, poor pestle design. Make the bulb with a rough surface to be able to pin a pill against the mortar so it can be crushed, and you'd have a great product.Didn't read the reviews before I bought, always a mistake. I purchased this to crush a small coated pill. The bottom of this mortar is beveled upward instead downward into a bowl. You can't balance a small coated pill on the top of the bevel and hope to crush it and the pestle ball is too big to get into the ring at the bottom edges of the mortar (picture shows this). Whether you have a small pill like mine or something larger even, you won't be able to get into the edge of the mortar to crush it up. This is useless and I am sending it back!I used it once and it broke, it felt plastique certainly not borosilicate or tempered.This was too small and delicate for my needs.

Can’t return it. I have no idea why. Wish that was made clearer / upfront :(IT WAS MISSING THE PESTLE WHEN IT ARRIVED. I TRIED TO GET A REPLACEMENT AND WAS TOLD IT'S NOT RETURNABLE. BUYER BEWARE.Bottom broke out of bowl during first useAfter one week of normal use...using it 1x per day......a chunk bbroke out of the bowl creating a hole.Bowl broke within 2 weeks of use.the bottom broke win one pice. lost valuable product!
